data.title: Apple Counting Adventure
data.description: Practice counting on from a known group of apples to find the total amount.

challenges.instruction: We already have 4 apples in the basket. Count on the rest to find the total!
challenges.hint: Start counting after 4. Touch each new apple as you count!
challenges.narration: There are 4 apples lined up. Let's count on to find out how many there are in total.

challenges.instruction: There are 6 apples ready. Can you count on to get the total count?
challenges.narration: We have 6 apples here. Count on from 6 to see the final number.

challenges.instruction: Start with 5 apples and count on to find the new total.
challenges.hint: Say 5, then touch the next apple and say 6!
challenges.narration: Begin with 5 apples and count on until you reach the end.

challenges.instruction: We have 7 apples counted out. Count on the rest of them!
challenges.hint: Remember the number 7, then keep counting the rest.
challenges.narration: Start from 7 and count on to find the big total.

challenges.instruction: Start from 3 apples and count on to finish the collection.
challenges.hint: Start at 3 and count each apple one by one.
challenges.narration: We start with 3 apples. Count on to find the final total.
